messages:
tess: Quick catch from design review — Console uses the label 'Target' in the service card but our docs and examples call it a 'route'. Users who click Help see two different words in quick succession.

omar: Huh, 'Target'? That's a new one. Where did that come from?

lydia: Legacy UI copy. We renamed a few things during the rewrite and one string slipped through. Docs still use 'route' because that's the manifest field (e.g. `route: /v1/pay`).

docs-bot: search-stats: "target" queries are low (~8%) vs "route" (~44%) and "endpoint" (~48%) over 90d.

tess: UX problem: the Help inlay is tiny on mobile — can't do long parentheticals like 'Target (route)'. It wraps badly. Also screen readers will read mismatch.

a11y: Accessibility note: current aria-label on the card is "Target details" while docs H1 says "Route reference". SR users will hear different labels. Need parity.

omar: Proposal: standardize to 'Route' in docs and Console, but add a short glossary alias in the Console UI that opens a modal: "Route = Target (UI label)". That keeps the manifest term primary and surfaces the UI name.

lydia: I'd prefer keeping docs canonical for technical accuracy. But marketing prefers 'Endpoint' for external pages. We should document mappings in the style guide: docs='route', console='Target' only if we cannot change quickly.

tess: Alternative: make Console label 'Route' (one-word swap) and add a tiny micro-link 'Why this word?' that opens the glossary anchor. That avoids layout issues. Might be simplest.

a11y: If we change UI text, update aria-labels to something like "Route info, opens glossary". Also ensure the micro-link is keyboard focusable and announces alias.

platform: Implementation note: small copy change is straightforward. I can deploy a targeted string update behind a feature flag. Also add a search synonym (target -> route) and a short redirect from /docs/target -> /docs/route for legacy links.

lydia: Docs action: I'll add a canonical /docs/route anchor and a one-line alias at top: "In the Console this is labeled 'Target'. In manifests it's 'route'." Also add a style-guide blurb.

tess: Design action: I'll mock the inlay micro-link vs direct renaming in Figma and test narrow widths. Will post frames by EOD.

platform: I'll queue the feature-flagged copy change and the search synonym in the next deploy window; will hold until docs commit is merged.

omar: Decision? Rename Console label to 'Route' or keep 'Target' + alias?

tess: Leaning to renaming to 'Route' in Console to keep parity with docs and reduce cognitive load. If marketing objects, we can show 'Endpoint' in marketing only. Owners: docs=lydia, design=tess, eng=platform.

lydia: I'll add the alias text and the redirect. Target EOD Thursday.

platform: I'll prepare the flag + PR and add analytics for glossary clicks.

omar: Sounds good. TL;DR: prefer 'Route' as canonical term across Console & docs; add micro glossary link and search synonym; update aria labels.

tess: Thanks — will upload Figma and run a quick SR pass when ready.
